remarks: Welcome to Woodside Green! Charming, fully updated studio in the heart of downtown Stamford, arranged like a onebedroom and ideally situated near parks, restaurants, shopping, UConn Stamford and public transportation. This wellmaintained condo features a brand new kitchen, a renovated bathroom and new flooring throughout, with an open layout that provides distinct living, dining and sleeping areas. Perfect for commuters and downtown living.
